item.title: AVATAR Director James Cameron Sets The Record Straight On Matt Damon's Payday Claims: "There Was Never A Deal"
item.description: After Bourne star Matt Damon claimed he missed out on as much as $250 million by turning down 2009's Avatar, filmmaker James Cameron has finally set the record straight.

item.title: 8 Best Marvel And DC Holiday Movies And TV Shows You Need To Watch This Christmas
item.description: It's that time of year again, and in this updated look at the best Marvel and DC Christmas-set movies and TV shows, we're ranking our yuletide favourites.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Shares Surprising Reaction To Their New MCU Costume: "This Is Not The Same At All"
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday star Simu Liu has shared his reaction to seeing his new Shang-Chi costume, admitting that it presented him with some unique challenges while shooting the movie's action scenes.

item.title: MAN OF STEEL Director Zack Snyder Shares Previously Unseen Shot From Henry Cavill's Superman Costume Test
item.description: Filmmaker Zack Snyder has shared another never-before-seen photo from his time working on Man of Steel, this time showing one of Henry Cavill's early costume tests as Superman.

item.title: Kevin Feige Reveals Emotional Last Day Of Filming For AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY In Hot Toys Anniversary Video
item.description: Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige has discussed the “emotional” last day of production for Avengers: Doomsday in a video recorded for Hot Toys’ 25th anniversary.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Will Likely Be The First AVATAR Movie That Fails To Reach $2 Billion Worldwide
item.description: It appears a third trip is one too many for some moviegoers, as Avatar: Fire and Ash has fallen short of industry estimates at both the domestic and international box offices this weekend.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Trailer #2 and #3 Runtimes Revealed; Doctor Doom Teaser Includes "Scary" Scenes
item.description: An international ratings board has revealed the runtimes for two more Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailers, and it sounds like things could get intense in the Doctor Doom sneak peek.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumored To Feature Major Psychological Struggle For Peter Parker
item.description: A new rumor has surfaced about Spider-Man: Brand New Day, claiming that Peter Parker will experience a fascinating psychological struggle.

item.title: James Ransone, Who Starred As Adult Eddie Kaspbrak In IT: CHAPTER TWO, Has Passed Away At 46
item.description: James Ransone, known for his starring and supporting roles in Sinister, The Wire, The Black Phone and It: Chapter Two has passed away at the age of 46.
